bearer.description:
Enter your JWT token.

To obtain a token, make a request to Auth0:

```bash
curl --request POST \
  --url https://dev-awqy75wdabpsnsvu.us.auth0.com/oauth/token \
  --header 'content-type: application/json' \
  --data '{
    "client_id":"YOUR_CLIENT_ID",
    "client_secret":"YOUR_CLIENT_SECRET",
    "audience":"https://sandbox.tesserx.co",
    "grant_type":"client_credentials"
  }'
```

The response will contain an `access_token` field which should be used as the Bearer token.

amount.description: Always null for deposits — see `estimated.to.amount` for the indicative target.

DepositDesiredOverlay.description: Caller's stated intent at creation. Frozen, never overwritten.

DepositEstimatedOverlay.description: Tesser's projection for how the deposit will proceed.

DepositActualOverlay.description: What actually settled. Populated when the deposit reaches a terminal state.

StepActualOverlay.description: Settled values once the step reaches a terminal state. All-null until then.

actual.description: Settled values once the step reaches a terminal state. All-null until then.

fees.description: List of fees associated with this step.

provider_key.description: Provider key used for this step (if applicable).

status_reasons.description: Array of reasons explaining the current status (if any).

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID the deposit belongs to.

desired.description: Caller's stated intent at creation. Frozen, never overwritten.

estimated.description: Tesser's projection for how the deposit will proceed.

actual.description: What actually settled. Populated when the deposit reaches a terminal state.

steps.description: Optional list of system-generated steps that make up this deposit route.

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the deposit expires, or null for auto-created deposits.

bank_identifier_code.description: Bank identifier code (routing number, sort code, etc.).

business_postal_code.description: Postal code (null when address isn't structured).

business_country.description: Country code (null when address isn't structured).

bank_swift_code.description: Bank SWIFT code (null for non-SWIFT rails like SPEI/SEPA).

belongs_to.description: Beneficiary business info (legal entity receiving the wire).

to_account.description: Wire instructions for completing the deposit.

DesiredOverlayRequest.description: Caller's stated intent for the deposit.

desired.description: Caller's stated intent for the deposit.

RebalanceDesiredOverlay.description: Caller's stated intent at creation. Frozen, never overwritten.

RebalanceEstimatedOverlay.description: Tesser's projection for how the rebalance will proceed.

RebalanceActualOverlay.description: What actually settled. Populated when the rebalance reaches a terminal state.

RebalanceStepActualOverlay.description: Settled values once the step reaches a terminal state. All-null until then.

step_sequence.description: Order of this step in the rebalance flow (1-based)

actual.description: Settled values once the step reaches a terminal state. All-null until then.

unsigned_transaction.description: Unsigned transaction bytes for client signing. Present only for Turnkey-signed steps in signature_requested status.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID the rebalance belongs to

desired.description: Caller's stated intent at creation. Frozen, never overwritten.

estimated.description: Tesser's projection for how the rebalance will proceed.

actual.description: What actually settled. Populated when the rebalance reaches a terminal state.

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the rebalance expires.

RebalanceDesiredOverlayRequest.description: Caller's stated intent for the rebalance.

desired.description: Caller's stated intent for the rebalance.

signature.description: Base64-encoded JSON envelope `{ body, stamp }` where `body` is the JSON-encoded Turnkey ACTIVITY_TYPE_SIGN_TRANSACTION_V2 activity and `stamp` is the X-Stamp header value produced by stamping that body. Tesser forwards the envelope to Turnkey to obtain the signed transaction.

network.description: Source blockchain network. Required when source is a self-custodial wallet.
